title: Static Upright-Neck Open-Fan Peacock
description: One complete newly authored static open-fan peacock-like bird. A low full torso rises into a thin upright curved neck and small crested head, with short pointed bill, lateral eyes, two whole folded wings and two finite cleft feet. Eleven thick individually tapered paddle-like train feathers spread radially from the rear body into a broad high fan with genuine contour gaps, each with integral contrasting tip-band faces. New complete bird sections, fan geometry and feet, not a parrot with longer feathers or a wading bird with duplicated wings. One model, zero scenes; stylised opaque static display only, no exact species, filament feathers, articulation, flight or real movement claim.
